findings.title: hyp.reduce with default ndims=None silently no-ops and returns model=None, while the docstring promises the fitted Reducer for return_model=True
findings.repro: env MPLBACKEND=Agg .venv/bin/python -c "import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp; x=np.random.randn(50,8); r,m=hyp.reduce(x,'PCA',return_model=True); print(np.asarray(r).shape, np.allclose(np.asarray(r),x), type(m))"
findings.expected: either documented ('ndims=None performs no reduction; the model slot is None') or a warning / a sensible default reduction
findings.actual: no-ndims reduced shape: (50, 8) | identical to input: True; PCA -> tuple len 2 | [1]: <class 'NoneType'> (also IncrementalPCA, UMAP); PCA ndims=3 -> [1]: <class 'hypertools.reduce.common.Reducer'>

findings.title: describe(max_dims=14) on 8-feature data silently plots components 2-13 with correlations flatlined at 1.0 past the true dimensionality
findings.repro: env MPLBACKEND=Agg .venv/bin/python -c "import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp; d=[np.random.randn(60,8)+i for i in range(3)]; hyp.describe(d, reduce='PCA', max_dims=14, show=False)"
findings.expected: x-axis capped at data dimensionality, or a UserWarning that max_dims > n_features
findings.actual: evidence PNG shows x-axis 2..13 for 8-feature data, correlation pinned at 1.00 from 8 onward; only warning emitted is the generic 'When input data is large, this computation can take a long time.'
